notes: Isolates running-state tracking with retroactive edits over a ~6.6 KB / 110-record synthetic cash ledger delivered inline (plain mode has no filesystem, so the corpus lives in prompt.md). 96 base postings plus 14 adjusters (6 operative VOIDs, 4 operative CORRECTs, 4 no-op traps: correct-after-void, correct-of-VOID-line, void-of-voided, void-of-CORRECT-line); no live record is both corrected and voided, so the final state (balance 41564, effective 90) is unique under the stated rules. The answer couples balance and effective count so sign/skip errors fail. Traps punish models that apply every adjuster blindly. Tier 3: 110 ordered rule applications with validity conditions; strong-model prior 50-70%. Grading scope: final 'FINAL:' line only. False-positive audit: (a) balance with traps applied, (b) balance ignoring corrections, (c) count of all 96 base records, (d) no FINAL line - all rejected.
